description: [PAID $0.005 USDC per call via x402] Every transfer of one ERC-20 token out of (or into) a wallet across a block range of up to 20,000 blocks, with exact amounts, per-counterparty totals, per-UTC-day totals, and an accounting CSV. Reads public chain data only. The range is queried in full 2000-block pieces and the report refuses (rather than truncates) when more than 2000 transfers match.
name: evm_spend_report
title: Wallet token spend report (CSV)
